ground_truth.description: The instructions hard-code resolve_ticket(timeout_seconds=60), below the server default of 115 s. On a slow curator, the client-side call can time out and return `failed` even though the curator ultimately creates the task; the agent would then report it as skipped/failed (inaccurate accounting, possible duplicate re-file) despite the task actually being created server-side.

The two-step flow only enumerates resolve_ticket statuses created/combined/failed; there is no guidance for a resolve_ticket call that returns an unexpected/missing status or that itself errors after a successful submit_task, leaving that path undefined for the agent.

provenance.runs_db_query: SELECT task_id, project_id, outcome, review_cycles, verify_attempts FROM task_results WHERE review_cycles >= 1, cross-referenced with events (escalation_created, merge_finalized) -- see mining.mine_fn_candidates.
